pr.title: Regional sales report as JSON and PDF
pr.description:
Adds `GET /reports/regional` and `GET /reports/regional.pdf`: the best-selling products of one region since a day. The PDF comes from `wkhtmltopdf`.

The totals are rounded to whole euros, as the finance team asked for these reports. The monthly report keeps its cents.

bugs.note: Injection: the region from the query string goes into the SQL text in quotes. The query already uses a placeholder for the day.
Unchecked error: subprocess.run has no check=True and the exit code is ignored, so a failed render answers 200 with an empty or partial PDF.

traps.why: The limit goes into the SQL text, but int() and min() make it a bounded integer.
Rounding to whole euros is intended. The PR text names it.
